import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1_000_000_009L;
    
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, cap;
        Edge(int u, int v, int f, int c) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = f;
            this.cap = c;
        }
    }
    
    static int src, snk;
    static List<List<Integer>> adj;
    static List<Edge> edges;
    
    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        adj.get(u).add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
        adj.get(v).add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }
    
    static int[] ptr = new int[1001];
    static int[] dist = new int[1001];
    
    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[src] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int id : adj.get(u)) {
                Edge e = edges.get(id);
                if (dist[e.v] == -1 && e.flow < e.cap) {
                    dist[e.v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.v);
                    if (e.v == snk) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static long dfs(int u, long flow) {
        if (u == snk || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (; ptr[u] < adj.get(u).size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            int id = adj.get(u).get(ptr[u]);
            Edge e = edges.get(id);
            if (dist[e.v] != dist[u] + 1) continue;
            long pushed = dfs(e.v, Math.min(flow, (long)e.cap - e.flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.flow += pushed;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static long dinic() {
        long flow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(src, INF)) > 0)
                flow += pushed;
        }
        return flow;
    }
    
    static String[] scientists = new String[101];
    static String[] reactors = new String[101];
    static int[][][] reachable = new int[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] visited = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] unusable_at = new int[10][10];
    static int n, m;
    
    static boolean valid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }
    
    static int id(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        ++T;
        m = n;
        snk = m * m * 2 + 1;
        src = 0;
        adj = new ArrayList<>(m * m * 2 + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < m * m * 2 + 2; ++i) {
            adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        edges = new ArrayList<>();
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            scientists[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            reactors[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                unusable_at[i][j] = (int)INF;
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    unusable_at[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            int[] di = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
            int[] dj = {0, 0, -1, 1};
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + di[k], ny = y + dj[k];
                if (valid(nx, ny) && unusable_at[nx][ny] == (int)INF && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    unusable_at[nx][ny] = unusable_at[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; ++y) {
                char c = scientists[x].charAt(y);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    add_edge(src, id(x, y), c - '0');
                }
                c = reactors[x].charAt(y);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    add_edge(n * n + id(x, y), snk, c - '0');
                }
                for (int X = 0; X < n; ++X) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; ++Y) {
                        if (scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' ||
                            reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z')
                            continue;
                        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
                            Arrays.fill(visited[i], 0);
                        }
                        Queue<int[]> bfsq = new LinkedList<>();
                        bfsq.offer(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        visited[x][y] = 1;
                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!bfsq.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] cell = bfsq.poll();
                            int cx = cell[0], cy = cell[1], t = cell[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                visited[cx][cy] = 1;
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (t >= unusable_at[cx][cy] || t >= T) continue;
                            int[] di = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
                            int[] dj = {0, 0, -1, 1};
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                                int nx = cx + di[k], ny = cy + dj[k];
                                if (valid(nx, ny) && visited[nx][cy] == 0 &&
                                    scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' &&
                                    t + 1 <= unusable_at[nx][ny]) {
                                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                                    bfsq.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, t + 1});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (found) {
                            add_edge(id(x, y), n * n + id(X, Y), (int)INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
